name: [⏰] every second add 1 skill point
desc:
Every second add 1 skill point (original) 

Private server is free, don't complain about no pvp toggle. 

ESA1SP

💪 You can become stronger every second 💪

⚔️ killing players can get 10% of their SP ⚔️
(maximum 10% of your total power + SP)

📈 Daily update maybe, but as there is only developer working, so there might be bugs. 📈 

Always save your inventory, as the server might reset randomly for updates.


Your like is our passion to keep developing. If you really don't like the game, Hope you could give some feedback rather than just giving a dislike 🙏
